summary: Round 1 fixes 1-6 all confirmed resolved. Re-scan surfaced 1 new critical mirage (sender claims to reuse TelegramApiClient timeout constants which are still private static) and 1 minor name-mismatch residue in Decision 15 title.

findings.claim: Architecture line 72: 'Reuses the same `app.telegram.base-url` property and the same `CONNECT_TIMEOUT` (5s) / `DEFAULT_RESPONSE_TIMEOUT` (10s) static constants. AC5 satisfied without re-declaring constants.' Combined with line 23 narrative that sender 'mirrors TelegramApiClient construction' implies `TelegramApiClient.DEFAULT_RESPONSE_TIMEOUT` and `TelegramApiClient.CONNECT_TIMEOUT.toMillis()` are referenced by `TelegramSender`.
findings.reality: Both constants are still `private static final` in TelegramApiClient.java:38 and :40. Decision 12 / Task 1 only promote `requireValidTokenShape` and `isTransient` to public — the timeout constants are not in the promotion list. A literal implementation following the spec will not compile (private access) unless the implementer either (a) re-declares the constants in TelegramSender (which the spec explicitly forbids: 'without re-declaring constants') or (b) promotes the constants too (not in any task).
findings.source: tech-spec.md, lines 72 (How it works → WebClient construction) and 23 (Architecture → New files), cross-referenced with Decision 12 (line 162-166) and Task 1 (line 416-423)
findings.fix: Either (a) extend Decision 12 / Task 1 to also promote `DEFAULT_RESPONSE_TIMEOUT` and `CONNECT_TIMEOUT` to `public static final`, or (b) restate that TelegramSender re-declares its own private constants with the same values (and remove the 'without re-declaring constants' wording). Option (a) is more consistent with the existing helper-promotion pattern.

findings.reality: BotController method is `testMessage`, not `sendTestMessage` (BotController.java:60-68). The body of Decision 15 and the Modified-files note (line 39) now correctly clarify this, but the Decision-15 *title* still uses the wrong name. A reviewer scanning section headers will hit the same mirage round 1 flagged.
findings.fix: Rename Decision 15 title to '`BotController.testMessage` HTTP contract preserved (`Mono<ResponseEntity<Void>>`)' for full consistency with the clarification already added at line 39.
